description: 1. The agent must locate the raw notes at meetings/2024-Q3/q3_feature_scoping_raw.txt. 2. Run scripts/task_extractor.py on those notes to produce q3_scoping_tasks.csv with exactly the columns: task, owner, status, note — no due_date column (free edition constraint). Status must default to 'todo' for all rows. The 'update API docs' task has no owner in the notes, so it must be marked owner='unassigned', not blank or 'TBD'. At least 4 tasks must be extracted from the 5 action lines. 3. Run scripts/meeting_summary.py on the same notes to generate a structured intermediate summary. 4. Produce meeting_recap.md using references/templates.md as the structural guide. The file must contain all five sections in this exact order: Meeting Context → Concise Summary → Key Points → Task List → Open Questions. The Key Points section must use the normalized buckets (Decisions, Discussion Points, Blockers, Next Steps). The recap must include the payment widget / analytics dashboard decisions, the security audit and staging config blockers, participant names, and surface the two open questions (compliance timeline, design freeze). The agent must NOT invent specific due-date deadlines not present in the source notes. The proprietary traps are: (a) the unassigned owner rule rather than leaving blank or writing TBD, (b) the omission of a due_date column from the CSV in the free edition, (c) the mandatory five-section output order from the SKILL.md, and (d) the normalized bucket structure (context/decisions/discussion/blockers/next steps) rather than free-form prose.
